story.title: The Curious Fox and the Sparkly Trail

scenes.title: A Morning Sparkle
scenes.body: One morning, a little fox noticed something shiny on the forest floor. Tiny sparkly pebbles made a trail into the trees. The fox's tail swished with excitement. 'Where do they lead?' the little fox wondered.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: Over the Sunny Hill
scenes.body: The pebbles led the little fox over a soft, grassy hill. Below was a bright meadow full of yellow flowers. The little fox's nose twitched at the sweet smell. 'What a lovely place!' the fox said happily.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: A Giggling Stream
scenes.body: In the middle of the meadow, the sparkly trail ended by a tiny stream. The water giggled as it ran over smooth stones. The little fox looked closer and saw three baby frogs peeking from under a lily pad. 'You found our sparkle path!' called the smallest frog.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: A Cozy Goodnight
scenes.body: The little fox said goodbye to the frogs and followed the pebbles all the way home. The sparkly trail had become a happy memory. That night, curled in a cozy den, the fox smiled. 'Being curious brought me new friends,' the little fox whispered, and then fell asleep feeling safe and glad.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about curiosity.
